The '''"Storm" Charge Suit''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armor]] used by the [[Security Police/Legends|Security Police]] within the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. It was manufactured by [[Corellian Arms/Legends|Corellian Arms]] and cost 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It could incapacitate an enemy who came into direct contact with it, due to an electrical discharge.<ref name="DC" />
